chunks: I have observed this matter thoroughly from all sides,
and turned it over, but I found no way except war or heresy regarding what Muhammad (peace be upon him) brought.
Certainly, there was over the people a ruler who brought about new (unIslamic) things and compelled the people to speak out. So they did speak, then rose up and thereafter changed the whole system.

key_terms.الْأَمْرَ: the matter / the affair of succession
key_terms.نَقَمُوا: they rose up / they took revenge / they changed

ai.seo_question: What political analysis does Imam Ali provide regarding the succession after the Prophet Muhammad?
ai.summary: In this famous discourse, Imam Ali (AS) describes his period of political quietism (Tawaqquf) after the Prophet's death, where he carefully weighed the options of armed conflict against the risk of fracturing the nascent Muslim community. He notes that while he scrutinized the 'affair' (Amr) thoroughly, he ultimately chose patience to preserve the unity of Islam, viewing the subsequent innovations (Bid'ah) and political shifts as tests of faith rather than immediate causes for war. This reflects the Shia scholarly view of Ali's strategic patience and his eventual rise to power only when the conditions were ripe and the people's support was solidified.
